exposure: LUS-muscular thickness measurement method (linear vs. curved array)
Timing of measurement (birth planning, preoperatively, intraoperatively)
pressure by fetal head/pelvis on the lower uterine segment (LUS) during LUS-muscular-thickness measurement
Pressure by fetal head/pelvis on the lower uterine segment (LUS) during measurement
outcome: Correlation between different LUS-muscular thickness measurement techniques
cohort: 33 women with a previous cesarean delivery
finding: The study found that there was no systematic difference in LUS-muscular thickness measurements between linear and curved array ultrasound probes, but measurements taken with pressure from the fetal head/pelvis on the LUS were significantly different from those taken without pressure.
